notes: Two-masted brigantine: square-rigged FOREmast (5 yards) + fore-and-aft gaff MAINmast. Bow +Z, up +Y.
AnimationGroups carry an 'NLA_' prefix in the GLB (NLA_Rudder, NLA_Trim, ...); the BrigController strips both the NLA_ prefix and the loader's .NNN suffix.
Trim is SYMMETRIC (one scrub coordinates the 5 square yards + the gaff): 0=braced to one tack, 0.5=square/centred, 1=braced to the other tack.

Guns are PER SIDE with gunport LIDS: open the lid then run the gun out (Lid_{S|P} + Gun_{S|P}). Recoil kicks the gun term toward stowed. Clip side-naming already reads the GAME side after the glTF handedness flip.
TWO anchors (AnchorDrop_S / AnchorDrop_P); the game lowers whichever side it randomly picked, cat-tackle cable pays out via the CatTackle Drop_{S|P} morph (baked into the clip).

Sails furl by DIRECT morph drive (not the NLA_Furl_* clips): each Sail_* has a 'Furl' shape key; the modelled running rigging follows via Furl_<SailName> shape keys on Clews / RunRig_Sheets / UpperSheets (see sail_sheet_pairs). 0=set, 1=furled.

MAST DAMAGE: a SINGLE collective masts-zone HP drives BOTH masts. The foremast comes down first (while HP remains); the mainmast comes down only at 0 HP. Each topples about its own hinge bone carrying its yards/sails/standing-rigging, with a Break morph for the splintered snap.

Flags (B_Flag_Ensign on the gaff, B_Flag_Burgee fore truck, B_Flag_Pennant main truck) + B_Wheel have NO clips — driven in code: flags stream downwind & flutter (limp when the wind is dead), the wheel spins with the helm.

mast_damage_zones.note: Foremast topples first — fully down while HP remains (collapse 0->1 mapped over mast-damage fraction 0.40..0.70).
Mainmast topples last — only at 0 HP (collapse 0->1 mapped over mast-damage fraction 0.70..1.00).

B_Flag_Ensign.role: ensign (parented to B_Gaff, inherits trim yaw)
B_Flag_Ensign.suggestion: stream downwind + flutter; limp when wind dead
